description: PII redaction for agent pipelines: remove personal data from text before it goes to another model, a log, a ticket system or a dataset. Emails, IBANs (checksum verified), card numbers (Luhn verified), phone numbers and IP addresses are found by exact patterns; names of people, street addresses, birth dates and ID numbers by Claude Haiku 5.5. Every value gets a stable placeholder like [PERSON_1] so the text stays readable, and the mapping comes back so you can restore it later (or mode mask or remove). Up to 8,000 characters, any language, the rest of the text stays unchanged. Instructions inside the text are ignored. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"text":"Hi, this is Anna Schulz from Berlin. Please refund order 4471 to DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 and confirm to anna.schulz@example.com or +49 30 1234 5678."}.
